sentences.en: Don't discriminate against people based on nationality, gender, or occupation.
sentences.zh: 不要因为国籍、性别或职业而歧视人。

sentences.en: All the people inside this room are the same gender.
sentences.zh: 这个房间里所有人都属于同一性别。

sentences.en: You should not discriminate against people based on their gender.
sentences.zh: 你不应该因为某人的性别而歧视他们。

senses.zh: 生（过去式gendered，过去分词gendered，现在分词gendering，第三人称单数genders，形容词genderless）
